notes: Read all 144 numbered source lines before editing. Native port follows the established dashboard idiom (OdometerCounterWidget / ChargingOptimizerWidget / BatteryHealthAnalyticsWidget): every not-yet-ported web dependency (WidgetShell, DataFreshness, Input, Badge, EmptyState icon, lucide-react, numberFormat, react-i18next, types) is reproduced inline native-safe with RN primitives + the shared native AppText/EmptyState/tokens and documented here. No DOM, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported.

L2 react-i18next useTranslation('dashboard') -> module-level English-default `t(key, fallback, vars?)` with {{var}} interpolation, keeping every widget.signalCatalog.* / freshness.* key verbatim; used in the title, EmptyStates, search placeholder, grouped Uncategorized fallback, and the freshness chip exactly where web called `t`.

L1-9 (transitive) the web WidgetShell + its DataFreshness chip are reproduced inline: `WidgetShell` -> loading -> skeleton (testID signal-catalog-loading); error -> centred errorBox + retry Pressable mirroring web <QueryError> (this widget never passes an error, so it is inert but preserved); titled -> header (BookGlyph + uppercase muted title + WidgetFreshness) over body; title-less (compact) -> body with WidgetFreshness overlaid top-right (web absolute top-1.5 right-1.5). `WidgetFreshness` -> same isError>fetching>stale>fresh precedence, dot colour tiers (emerald-400/sky-400/amber-400/red-400), 'just now / Nm/Nh/Nd/Nw ago' relative ladder, 'updating…'/'error' labels, a 30s re-render tick, and onRefresh wired to a Pressable (testIDs signal-catalog-freshness / -dot).

Companion __tests__/SignalCatalogWidgetParity.test.tsx mocks useVehicles (useVehicles module) and useSignalCatalog/useSignalObservations (useTelemetry module) and renders: catalog-loading skeleton; title-less compact view (cols<=1: count + 'signals available', freshness overlay, no 'Signal Catalog' header, no list); standard view header + search box; grouped + alphabetically-sorted categories with per-category counts; per-signal unit Badge + observation count (grouped from observations by signal_name); search filtering by name/description/source_module incl. the no-results EmptyState; the no-data EmptyState inside the shell when the catalog is empty (section never hidden); and the vehicleId fallback to the first vehicle id vs an explicit vehicleId prop passed to useSignalObservations. Every test unmounts so the 30s freshness interval leaves no open handle.
